– 23 November 2026 – This holiday season, LANDMARK invites guests to check in to a world of timeless magic with "Christmas at The Gloucester Hotel", welcoming visitors at LANDMARK ATRIUM from

Created in collaboration with acclaimed London-based creative studio CLOSER, the multi-level spectacle marks the studio's first-ever holiday installation in Hong Kong. Merging exceptional craftsmanship, architectural history and artistry, the experience reimagines the glamour of Central's historic 1932 Gloucester Hotel through a storybook lens; HSBC's iconic lions are also collaborating with LANDMARK for the first time, spreading festive cheer. Ushering in a vibrant new chapter for Destination CENTRAL, the installation builds upon the district's cultural momentum, unlocking a refreshed Central Passport featuring stamp-and-win experiences and over 50 dining privileges. Together with
, presented jointly by Hongkong Land and the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB), Central shines as the city's ultimate festive playground.

revives the glamour of festive travel through an enchanting storybook lens. Paying homage to the historic 1932 landmark that once stood on this very address, the installation reawakens the soul of the original Gloucester Hotel — a defining social destination crowned atop the Gloucester Building, famed for elegant lounges and terraces that drew the city's elite. Today, the spectacle brings the address to life through a charming festive fable: founded by teddy bear hotelier Cornelius Claus — the "Duke of Christmas" — the hotel is reopened today by his grandson, Concierge Edmund "Teddy" Claus. Mr. Alexander Li, Head of Asset Management, Hong Kong Central, Hongkong Land Limited, said:

"Building on the momentum of our Tomorrow's CENTRAL transformation and Destination CENTRAL, we are delighted to honour LANDMARK's storied heritage of hospitality by reimagining the historic 1932 Gloucester Hotel alongside CLOSER. Through this golden-age spectacle, we warmly invite our entire community and visitors from around the world to check in, feel right at home, and celebrate the magic of the season together."
Ms. Faye McLeod, Co-Founder, CLOSER, said:

"Christmas is a time of wonder, and our ambition is to create something truly special, crafted with love. Inspired by LANDMARK's rich heritage, we reimagine the Gloucester Hotel as a place of magical exploration for children and adults alike. Every detail is brought to life with artisanal precision and thoughtful storytelling, evoking the glamour of the golden age of travel while capturing the enchantment, curiosity and delight of the festive period."
Destination CENTRAL Evolves into a District-Wide Celebration

As the second chapter of LANDMARK's Destination CENTRAL, "Christmas at The Gloucester Hotel" anchors the district's holiday spirit as the gateway to an inspiring winter journey. Spreading festive cheer across the neighbourhood, the much-loved Central Passport returns in a refreshed postcard-themed edition designed as a collectible keepsake. Visitors can embark on a citywide stamp trail across designated Central checkpoints, and collect three stamps to enter a lucky draw at the Destination CENTRAL Redemption Counter on 2/F, LANDMARK ATRIUM — with a chance to win up to 66,000 Asia Miles alongside exclusive holiday gifts — while enjoying curated dining privileges at more than 50 participating partners, including Lan Kwai Fong, The Murray, and Ocean Park.

LANDMARK represents the epitome of top-tier luxury shopping and lifestyle experiences. Drawing from a rich heritage which began in 1904 – LANDMARK today is the luxury shopping destination of Hongkong Land's Central portfolio including 4 iconic connected buildings, LANDMARK ATRIUM, LANDMARK ALEXANDRA, LANDMARK CHATER and LANDMARK PRINCE'S. LANDMARK offers approximately 208 of the finest stores and restaurants, all seamlessly linked by pedestrian bridges. From high fashion and accessories to watches and jewellery, from luxury living to beauty and grooming, from international cuisine to authentic gourmet dining, LANDMARK brings the ultimate shopping experience to the discerning customer.

Hongkong Land is a major listed property investment, management and development group. The Group focuses on developing, owning and managing ultra-premium mixed-use real estate in Asian gateway cities, featuring Grade A office, luxury retail, residential and hospitality products. Its mixed-use real estate footprint spans more than 850,000 sq. m., with flagship projects in Hong Kong, Singapore and Shanghai. Its properties hold industry leading green building certifications and attract the world's foremost companies and luxury brands. The Group's Hong Kong Central portfolio represents some 450,000 sq. m. of prime property. The Group has a further 165,000 sq. m. of prestigious office space in Singapore mainly held through joint ventures and five retail centres on the Chinese mainland, including a luxury retail centre at Wangfujing in Beijing. In Shanghai, the Group owns a 43% interest in a 1.1 million sq. m. mixed-use project in West Bund, which is due to be completed in 2028. Hongkong Land Holdings Limited is incorporated in Bermuda and has a primary listing on the London Stock Exchange, with secondary listings in Bermuda and Singapore. Hongkong Land is a member of the Jardine Matheson Group. News Source: LANDMARK
